correctness.rationale: The proof derives the exact modal characteristic polynomial from the defining AggMo recurrence. It proves small-step stability, excludes every nonreal unit-circle crossing by the identity \(\operatorname{Im}((1-z)\overline{H(z)})=-\sin\theta\sum_i(1-\beta_i)/D_i\), identifies the unique crossing at \(z=-1\), and uses the exact sign of \(P_s(-1)\) to prove necessity above the boundary. Diagonalization of the SPD Hessian then makes the top curvature \(L\) decisive.

value.rationale: The formula \(s_\star=2\,\operatorname{HM}(1+\beta_i)\) directly quantifies the stability tradeoff at the core of passive damping. It gives exact safe steps for arbitrary damping vectors, explains why the absolute ceiling cannot exceed that of the highest-\(\beta\) single buffer, and still leaves room for AggMo's documented improvement in oscillation suppression and interior convergence behavior. The default vectors and geometric family obtain immediate closed-form consequences.
